name: AI Chatbot by Botami – WordPress AI Chatbot for Support, Sales & Lead Gen
author: botami2025

sections.description:
AI Chatbot by Botami is a production-ready AI chatbot for WordPress that automates customer support, increases conversions, and engages users 24/7. It plugs into any theme and can be trained on your own knowledge base for precise, brand-safe answers.

Built for speed, privacy, and real business outcomes, Botami helps you reduce ticket volume, qualify leads, and guide users to action with natural, intelligent conversations.

Key Benefits

  • Reduce support workload and first-response time
  • Increase conversion rate on key pages
  • Capture and qualify leads automatically
  • Provide instant, multilingual assistance 24/7
  • Maintain privacy with GDPR-aligned data handling

Core Features

  • AI-powered conversations with context awareness
  • Real-time chat UI with instant responses
  • Customizable widget (colors, copy, position)
  • URL/page-level exclusions for fine control
  • Mobile-first, performance-optimized
  • Multilingual input/output and interface
  • Secure storage with data-deletion controls

Premium Features

  • Train on PDFs and private URLs (knowledge base)
  • Custom avatar and full branding
  • Chat analytics, export, and transcripts
  • Priority support and onboarding

Compatibility

  • Page builders: Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi
  • Caching/CDN: compatible with major page caches and CDNs
  • Themes: works with all modern WordPress themes

Popular Use Cases

  • Customer Support: answer FAQs, policies, returns, billing
  • Sales Assistant: guide users through services and pricing
  • Lead Generation: qualify prospects and collect contact details
  • Onboarding & Docs: route users through key flows
  • Education/Content: summarize and point to relevant pages

Privacy Policy

This plugin:
– Stores chat messages locally (optional)
– Shares no data with third parties without your consent
– Allows complete data deletion on uninstall

Full policy: https://botami.ai/privacy

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  • Alpine.js (v3.x) – Lightweight JavaScript framework

    • Minified file: assets/js/alpine.min.js
    • Source: https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
    • License: MIT License

  • create-file-list – File list utility for file uploads

    • Minified file: assets/js/create-file-list.min.js
    • Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-file-list
    • License: MIT License
    • Note: Utility function to create FileList objects from File arrays

  • Flowbite – UI component library

    • Minified file: assets/js/flowbite.min.js
    • Source: https://github.com/themesberg/flowbite
    • License: MIT License

  • Tailwind CSS (v2.2.19) – CSS framework

    • Minified file: assets/css/tailwind-botami.min.css
    • Source code: src/tailwind.css and assets/css/tailwind-src.css
    • Build configuration: tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js
    • Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
    • License: MIT License
    • Build instructions: Run npm install then npm run build:css to rebuild

All source code and build tools are available in the plugin’s GitHub repository: https://github.com/Userseven/wordpress_chatbot_plugin

Additional Information

  • Plugin works best with an HTTPS-enabled website
  • Regular backups are recommended before updates
  • Support is available at botami.ai/support

For more information, visit Botami.ai
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/botami-chatbot/ or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Botami Chatbot.
  4. Enter your Botami API key from https://botami.ai to start chatting.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. Create an account at https://botami.ai to obtain your API key.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin is designed with privacy by default. Data is processed securely, stored under your control, and can be deleted at any time.

Can I train the AI Chatbot on my content?

Yes in Premium: upload PDFs or connect private URLs to build a dedicated knowledge base.

Can I customize the appearance and language?

Yes. You can set colors, texts, greetings, and use multilingual interface and replies.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. The widget is responsive and optimized for Core Web Vitals.

Will it slow down my site?

The front-end is lightweight. Server work is offloaded to the Botami API to keep pages fast.
